remarks: A grand home in a private estate setting. You will be awed by the stunning 2 story great room surrounded by French doors leading to stone terraces. A gracious entertaining space with it's own caterer's kitchen. This flexible 7 bedroom home is easily adaptable to your needs. Perhaps 2 offices, a gym, a studio for yoga or artistic endeavors, a nanny suite? All the charm and character of this 1910 vintage build updated to meet today's lifestyle. A large, gourmet kitchen opens to the light filled family room perfect for casual gatherings. The elegant formal dining room and butler's pantry makes entertaining a joy. This home must be seen to be fully appreciated. It will surprise and delight you! There is a detached 2-car garage with walk-up, finished space above for storage or activities. The outdoor sport court is an added bonus in the beautifully landscaped property. Call for an appointment to see this gem today!
